label: D2 after choosing a2 and reaching S2 (common) on a rewarded streak, high value
explanation: Reset gate 5 is never active at GO and fires almost only after a2 is chosen: 89% of its mass is at D2 when the agent chose a2 and reached S2 (common), with the previous trial rewarded and the model value high (>8). It is essentially silent after a1 or after reaching S1, and after an unrewarded previous trial. A weaker part (11% of mass, low magnitude) is at D1 when a reward is shown after an a2->S2 trial. Magnitude is largest on the first a2->S2c of a rewarded run and decays over consecutive repeats (top windows ~1.0 then 0.68 then 0.57). It also has a strong episode-time dependence: active in episode trials 10-59, absent after trial 60 and in the first 3 trials, so precision is limited (dev F1 0.70, mass recall 0.88). All variables used are observed at D2 (value is the model value output).
